status: Completed saved-evidence comparison; no native parity verdict
mask_policy: The extra capsule masks are a fixed Android72 sampling model, not a fitted native outline, an alpha mask or a proven native corner radius. No geometry is normalized to fit them. Full same-world crops preserve observed silhouette differences.

model_masks.model_interior_eroded3: Signed distance to frozen72 production layout capsule<=-3dp.
model_masks.model_outer_rim_2pt: Absolute signed distance<=2dp; covers the complete modeled edge except declared source-role exclusions.
model_masks.model_left_endcap_2pt: Outer-rim shell at x<left semicircle center.
model_masks.model_right_endcap_2pt: Outer-rim shell at x>right semicircle center.
model_masks.model_upper_right_rim_2pt: Outer-rim shell above center with world x>=123dp.
model_masks.model_lower_straight_rim_2pt: Lower-rim shell between the frozen capsule's semicircle centers.
model_masks.model_exterior_shadow_2to6pt: Signed distance>2 and<=6dp, outside the frozen72 production capsule.

world_mapping: None. Native world origin is observed window(0,0); Android uses the report's actual background source screen origin and density. Android is sampled once onto the native2px/pt world grid. No thumb-bounds fitting, center realignment, per-scene registration, phase compensation, color normalization or contrast fitting between platforms.
rail_exclusion: All material diagnostic windows exclude world |y-430|<=8pt, including selected rail and conservative halo. The whole raw crop is retained for visual review but receives no aggregate material score.
title_exclusion: Native SwiftUI title actual bounds are x20..118,y382.5..402pt. A conservative upper-left influence area x<123,y<430 is excluded from material windows. This is a declared source-dependent exclusion, not proof of finite blur/refraction support; foreground source influence may extend farther.
phase_limit: Native REST precedes actual delivered DOWN; native HELD is a captured display bracketed by actual delivered DOWN/UP, with capture starting0.65s+ after DOWN. Android HELD records Compose DOWN/CANCEL injection and active held state on a declared controlled Compose clock settled>=1600ms; no independent raw Android platform receipt trace. These are stable-state comparisons, not equivalent natural-time samples.
metric_limit: Luminance/background slope and contrast ratios are apparent image diagnostics, not physical transmission/opacity. Channel-gradient spread is a dispersion-sensitive proxy confounded by background color, refraction, highlights and rasterization; it cannot identify a physical dispersion coefficient.
comparison_scope: Single-slider fixed positiveA2.15/bevel5.5/quadraticD5/W6.5; adds an inset-local total-frost replacement1.1dp with gates1.5-2 and6.5-7dp. Range remains isolated. Source field, dispersion, rail and geometry stay fixed. No physical thickness or native kernel identified.
negative_control_policy: Report all REST and source differences exactly. Whole-crop REST includes the rail, which is intentionally changed; a whole-crop change alone is not a material negative-control failure.
holdout_policy: synthetic_landscape is reported separately and never tunes masks/metrics or selects parameters. No new independent holdout is claimed for these previously observed scenes.
all_changes: All strict increases and decreases retained with no suppression threshold. Overlapping masks are descriptive repeated measures, not independent samples or a pooled similarity score.
no_adoption: No automatic adoption or full-product acceptance.
